evals.prompt: commit everything - I've been working on fixing engine timing and lifecycle handling across entities, runtime, and the engine. There are also some changes in hyphae. Break it all into clean commits and push when done.
evals.expected_output: Multiple scoped conventional commits: submodule (hyphae) committed first, then parent commits grouped by concern (engine timing, lifecycle nodes, logic nodes, etc.), submodule ref update folded into a relevant commit, then prompted for push with submodules pushed before parent.

assertions.text: Submodule commits appear before parent commits
Changes grouped into multiple scoped commits
Parent commits include submodule pointer update

evals.expected_output: Commits the hyphae submodule change, then commits the submodule pointer update in the parent repo, pushes hyphae first then parent.

assertions.text: Parent gets submodule pointer update commit
